title: Affected-tests-first: time share of the selected subset on real-commit cases
summary: Deterministic measurement, no model calls: each of 47 test modules timed at HEAD (4 parallel workers, so absolute times are inflated but ratios hold), then for the 40 EVS-TEST-SELECTION cases the import-graph selection's share of total module time. Failing attempts get their signal after the subset (mean 36%, median 21% of full-suite time); passing attempts pay the subset on top of the full suite. Break-even first-attempt failure rate ~36%. 13 affected modules were missed across 40 cases (the full suite still runs afterwards, so misses delay but never hide a failure).
